title: Journal entry testing — Larkin Textiles
instructions: An ADA on **Larkin Textiles'** general ledger flagged the entries below. Decide which to select for fraud-related testing.

exhibits.title: Flagged entries
exhibits.content:
1. A $480,000 manual entry to revenue posted by the CFO on the last day of the year, with no support attached.
2. A recurring monthly depreciation entry generated automatically.
3. Entries posted on a Sunday by a user who isn't in accounting.
4. Round-dollar entries of $250,000 to an intercompany suspense account.
5. The automated monthly payroll accrual entry.
6. An entry reversing a December sales accrual on January 2.

parts.prompt: Select each entry for testing or not.

rows.explanation: Large, manual, unsupported, by senior management at period-end.
Routine automated entries have low fraud risk.
Unusual timing and an unexpected user.
Round amounts to seldom-used accounts are red flags.
Reversals after year-end may indicate improper revenue.
